Brand Introduction

Diantha is a premier brand dedicated to offering high-quality skincare solutions that blend advanced technology with elegance. Our mission is to empower individuals to achieve radiant and healthy skin through innovative products. We take pride in our commitment to excellence, ensuring that each product delivers exceptional results and a luxurious experience. Our ultrasonic face spatula embodies this ethos, combining cutting-edge features with a sleek design to enhance skincare routines.

Product Description

The Diantha Ultrasonic Face Spatula is a state-of-the-art skincare tool designed for women seeking a professional-level facial treatment at home. This advanced device utilizes high-frequency ultrasonic waves to deeply cleanse and exfoliate the skin, promoting a healthier and more radiant complexion. The spatula features a stainless steel blade that serves as an efficient conductor of ultrasonic waves, ensuring optimal performance and durability.

Incorporating blue light therapy across all modes, the spatula helps to reduce inflammation and fight acne-causing bacteria, contributing to clearer skin. The device also includes Ion technology, with both positive and negative ion modes, which work to enhance skin absorption of serums and other skincare products while removing impurities. This combination of features makes the Diantha Ultrasonic Face Spatula an essential tool for achieving a spa-quality facial experience at home.

Unique Selling Point (USP)

The Diantha Ultrasonic Face Spatula stands out with its comprehensive blend of advanced technologies. Unlike other facial devices, it integrates high-frequency ultrasonic waves with blue light therapy and versatile Ion technology, all in a single, elegant design. This multi-functional approach ensures deep cleansing, enhanced product absorption, and improved skin clarity, making it an all-in-one solution for a luxurious and effective skincare routine.

The device is waterproof, and suitable for sensetive skin inlcuding mild rosacea. Use your favorite essential oils, serums, and creams with the device for obsoprtion and cleaning.

No more harsh chemicals on your face. 

Payment Terms

Affiliates will earn a 15% commission on every sale generated through their unique affiliate link. Payments will be processed on a monthly basis. Affiliates must meet a minimum payout threshold of $50 before receiving payment. All payments will be made via PayPal, bank transfer, debit card, or venmo, as per the affiliate’s preference. A detailed sales report will be provided to affiliates to ensure transparency and accurate tracking of their commissions.

Other Information

  • Affiliate Support: Our affiliate program includes dedicated support to help you with any questions or concerns. We provide marketing materials, including banners, product images, and promotional content to assist you in driving sales.
    - Tracking & Reporting: We use a reliable affiliate tracking platform to ensure accurate tracking of referrals and commissions. Affiliates will have access to real-time reports to monitor their performance and earnings.
    - Cookie Duration: Affiliates benefit from a 30-day cookie duration, meaning if a customer makes a purchase within 30 days of clicking your affiliate link, you will receive a commission for that sale.
    - Program Terms: Affiliates are expected to promote our products in a manner that aligns with our brand values. We reserve the right to review and approve promotional methods to ensure they meet our standards.

You can be upgraded for higher commissions (Up to 30%) with a higher selling volume.

Please check our homepage and science page on our website for more informations: https://dianthabeauty.com/
